name: Inevitable Recovery
body:
You are more like arbiters who remain on their homeplane.

Prerequisites: Inevitable Construction, arbiter.

Benefit: You have fast healing 2, which cannot heal chaotic damage and ceases to function for 1 minute any time you take chaotic damage. You can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function.
